title: 第13章 你们想死吗第14章 嘴强王者
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 林羽洗过澡，打开手机一看，发现此刻已经没有了信号和网路。
“看来，信号塔已经遭到破坏了。”
刚来到大厅。
“兄弟，你也太不厚道了吧。”
“属性果实那麽重要，你随便用一点吃的，就把我们全换走了，打发叫花子呢？”
“就是就是，你最好把属性果实都还我们。”
一堆人围了过来。
这次，他们每个人手中，都拿着不少武器。
有棍棒，钢管，消防斧之类的。
“小子，你最好把属性果实都交出来，等国家清理丧尸之後，你杀人的事情，我们可以替你隐瞒。”
一个肥头大耳，穿着西装的男人道。
“呵！你们……想死吗？”
林羽露出一口大白牙，阴恻恻的笑了起来。
看来，昨天杀了两个人，没让这些人害怕啊。
“大哥，求你了，把属性果实还我们吧，不然我们活不下去的。”
就在林羽准备动手的时候，几个人突然跪了下来，哭诉道。
合着刚刚是占着人多，想要威逼。
眼看自己要发怒，立刻就怂了。
“昨天的交易，我可没有逼迫任何一个人，再逼逼我就不客气了。”
一声怒喝，吓得所有人一哆嗦。
林羽懒得理会，带着陈静儿走到门口，朝黄毛招了招手。
“大佬，有什麽事？”黄毛满脸堆笑，小跑过来，一脸谄媚。
“开门！”林羽说道。
黄毛一惊，外面可是有很多丧尸的。
今早还有好几只从酒店门口经过，吓得他们一点声音都不敢发出。
“啊什麽，开门！”林羽眉头一皱。
“可是丧……丧尸！”黄毛一脸惧怕，语气都结巴了起来。
“你们自己有多少食物自己清楚，等食物吃完了，你们也是死。”
“给你们个善意的忠告，趁着现在丧尸还不是很强大，你们带着工具，几个人一起是可以轻松杀死丧尸的。”
“击杀丧尸，才能变强。丧尸会不断进化，等再过几天，丧尸都进化升级了，你们就只能等死了。”
说完，林羽不再理会众人。
目光锐利的看着黄毛：“你要是不想出去就守好这道门，我们晚点就回来。”
“好的，好的。”黄毛胆战心惊。
林羽的目光彷佛能杀人，吓得他腿软。
content_en:
Lin Yu took a shower, turned on his mobile phone and found that there was no signal or Internet at this moment.
"It appears that the signal tower has been damaged."
Just arrived at the lobby.
"Brother, you are too unkind."
"Attribute fruits are so important. You just use some food to replace us all and send us away as beggars?"
"That's right, you'd better return all the attribute fruits to us."
A crowd of people gathered around.
This time, each of them held many weapons in their hands.
There are sticks, steel pipes, fire axes and the like.
"Boy, you'd better hand over all the attribute fruits. After the country cleans up the zombies, we can hide your murder for you."
A fat man wearing a suit said.
"Ha! Do you...want to die?"
Lin Yu showed his big white teeth and smiled sadly.
It seems that killing two people yesterday did not scare these people.
"Brother, please, please return the attribute fruit to us, otherwise we won't be able to survive."
Just when Lin Yu was about to take action, several people suddenly knelt down and cried.
Co-author just took advantage of the crowd and wanted to intimidate.
Seeing that he was about to get angry, he immediately gave up.
"I didn't force anyone on yesterday's transaction, and I won't be polite if I force you again."
"Get out!"
An angry shout made everyone tremble.
Lin Yu was too lazy to pay attention, took Chen Jing'er to the door, and waved to Huang Mao.
"Boss, what's the matter?" Huang Mao trotted over with a smile on his face, a flattering look on his face.
"Open the door!" Lin Yu said.
"Ah!"
Huang Mao was shocked. There were many zombies outside.
Several of them passed by the hotel this morning, and they were so frightened that they didn't dare to make a sound.
"Ah what, open the door!" Lin Yu frowned.
"But... zombies!" Huang Mao looked frightened and stuttered in his tone.
"You know how much food you have. When the food is gone, you will die too."
"I would like to give you a kind advice. While the zombies are not very strong yet, you can easily kill them with tools and a few people together."
"You can become stronger by killing zombies. Zombies will continue to evolve. In a few days, the zombies will have evolved and upgraded, and you will have no choice but to wait to die."
After speaking, Lin Yu ignored everyone.
He looked at Huang Mao with sharp eyes: "If you don't want to go out, just guard this door. We will come back later."
"Okay, okay." Huang Mao was frightened.
Lin Yu's eyes seemed to be able to kill people, making him weak in the legs.
